ticket: #99 / T13 — safe server reason, action and task projection
batch: P4 / T13 — HTTP task_state, safe reasons, binding, constraints and resource state

code.prompt_version: unchanged prompt role contracts; execution snapshot schema 1.1.0 (reads stored 1.0.0)

environment.adapters: LLMStub and VisualStub with counting; no real provider or network call

scope.task_state: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/workflow now always returns task_state with progress (phase/stage/stage_label/status/awaiting_user/terminal, no percentage), safe reason, task binding, constraint strengths and current-vs-history resource state.
scope.safe_reason: Only needs_input/blocked/failed runs with an issue code or known template expose a reason. The projection never reads run.issue_message or reviewer prose; unknown templates fall back to generic safe copy. Categories cover missing_information, repairable_composition, true_drift, content_rejection, missing_evidence, protocol_error, technical_failure, remote_unknown and authorization_invalid.
scope.actions: ActionView now carries server-derived effect, read_only, requires_model_call, retry_mode and automatic_retry. Read-only verification is separate from manual recovery; automatic_retry is always false; no cancel action or fake percentage is added.
scope.approvals: ApprovalView.checks is reduced to the confirmation envelope only. Reviewer notes, candidate bodies and private locators stored in checks_json are not projected. A candidate artifact keeps payload=None until approved.
scope.binding: task_state.binding carries project/run/revision/intent/job/delivery and both confirmed and active snapshot digests. current is false when project revision or the job's confirmed snapshot digest no longer matches the active authorization.
scope.resource_state: current_version is only populated when binding.current and the delivery asset matches the current job. Older published versions stay in history and cannot make a current pending task look complete; unknown stays unknown.
scope.normal_recovery: Normal S08 and S12 recovery states produce the same safe reason fields for the same persisted issue; no restart-only branch changes the projection semantics.
scope.compatibility: The new WorkflowView.task_state and action fields are additive; existing issue/artifact/approval/version fields remain. main/src/api/workflow.ts mirrors the response types with optional action metadata for old fixtures.
